sociability.mid: keeps a fair balance of time alone and time with others

minimalism.high: prefers a clean space with nothing unnecessary in it
minimalism.mid: keeps things tidy while still holding onto favorite pieces
minimalism.low: loves filling a space with favorite things and objects

activity.high: likes staying physically active even at home
activity.mid: stays active while still valuing rest
activity.low: values comfortable rest at home above all else

openness.mid: likes a layout that's open but still keeps some coziness
openness.low: feels most at ease in a familiar, stable layout

nature.high: values natural light and greenery above all in a space
nature.mid: likes a moderate touch of nature woven in
nature.low: values practicality and function over natural elements
